text.tspan: A cartographer returns to a city that has erased every street she
remembers—and finds one stranger still living inside her old map.

svg.text: What people you trust are loving tonight

text.tspan: A linguist receives one message from a future that never happened.
To answer it, she has to remember a life she never lived.
